occupation, income, living standards, and perceptions of economic conditions in Berlin shortly after the early‑1950s, relevant for studying economic systems and development during that decade."},{"title":"Social Structure, Social Mobility and Social Change in Berlin 1952–1953","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8018","justification":"Historical survey material on Berlin’s social structure and mobility in the early 1950s, containing information on occupational structure and economic situation useful for analyzing development under different economic systems in the city."},{"title":"Berlin Population Survey 1951 (West Berlin)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8017","justification":"Early‑1950s survey of West Berlin residents covering living conditions, employment, and post‑war reconstruction context, allowing analysis of economic development in that specific part of the divided city."},{"title":"Economic Situation of Refugees and Expellees in Berlin, 1953","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8034","justification":"Focuses on refugees and expellees in Berlin and collects data on employment, income, and housing, directly reflecting economic integration and development dynamics in early‑1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Industrial Workers in West Berlin, 1954","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8041","justification":"Survey of industrial workers’ employment, working conditions, and economic security in West Berlin, relevant for evaluating industrial development and labor market characteristics of the 1950s economic system."},{"title":"Living Conditions in West Berlin 1955","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8043","justification":"Captures details on household income, consumption, and housing in West Berlin mid‑1950s, providing evidence on economic development and standards of living under the West German economic system."},{"title":"Berlin Workers and the Economy, 1956","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8052","justification":"Analyzes workers’ employment status, wages, and attitudes toward economic policy and reconstruction, directly tied to economic development in Berlin’s mid‑1950s context."},{"title":"Economic Expectations and Consumer Climate in Berlin, 1957","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8061","justification":"Survey on consumer expectations, purchasing power, and evaluation of the economic situation in Berlin, useful for assessing perceived development and functioning of the economic system in the late 1950s."},{"title":"Berlin Household Budget Survey 1958","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8074","justification":"Detailed data on income, expenditures, and consumption patterns of Berlin households, enabling analysis of economic development, welfare, and distribution in the city’s 1950s economy."},{"title":"Berlin Economic Development and Social Change, 1959","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8080","justification":"Study of the relationship between economic transformation, employment structure, and social change in Berlin at the end of the 1950s, directly addressing economic systems and development issues."}]}
